programmes.d: While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

A global summit fails to stop a massive asteroid headed straight for Earth. With the outlook now bleak, a young tech genius assembles her own team of specialists, using aeronautics, in a last-ditch effort to stop the asteroid before it's too late.

programmes.t: Sinbad And The War Of The Furies
programmes.d: On a treasure hunt gone wrong, modern-day adventurer Sinbad accidentally releases the Furies, three beautiful but terrible ancient beings powerful enough to threaten life on Earth.
When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.
A small-town lawman (A Martinez) leads the fight for survival when a military defense network sends its army of deadly cyborgs on a mission to wipe out humanity.
